---
title: "Interface"
---

This section of the documentation focuses on how the interface is
implemented. It is split into the following set of documents:

-   The [Inputs](inputs.qmd) accepted by Flower.
-   The [Outputs](outputs.qmd), including the different styles
    of splitting content into multiple pages.
-   The [Command Line Interface](cli.qmd) that
    forms the main entry point to flower.
-   The [Python interface](python.qmd) that calls flower
    from within Python code.
-   The [Configuration file](cli.qmd) which allows
    for configuration options to be stored in a text file.
